# Baseline for parser/corpus_test.go's TestSVTestsCorpusMatchesBaseline.
#
# One "path expected-count # reason" line per vendored file that produces a
# nonzero preprocessor+parser error count. Every entry is deliberate: either
# an intentional sv-tests negative test (:should_fail_because:), or a
# genuinely out-of-scope construct for a declaration-grade parser (see
# the design note in ../parser/corpus_test.go). Any file NOT listed here
# is expected to produce zero errors -- a regression there fails the test
# the same as a baseline mismatch does.
#
# Updating this file is a deliberate act, not a formality: a new entry
# should come with a real reason, and a removed entry should mean a genuine
# fix landed (with its own commit, its own tests) -- never a silent baseline
# regeneration.

# --- Intentional sv-tests negative tests (:should_fail_because:) ---
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_12.sv 1 # should_fail_because: fewer actual than formal macro args with no default for the rest
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_18.sv 2 # should_fail_because: function-like macro invoked without parentheses
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_21.sv 3 # should_fail_because: macro text split across string literals; the unterminated string corrupts the initial statement's own token stream too, reported as "expected ';' before \"endmodule\"" -- was 4 while the statement skip ran to EOF (taking endmodule with it, so the container reported its own unexpected-EOF as well)
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_6.sv 1 # should_fail_because: fewer actual than formal macro args with no default for the rest
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_7.sv 1 # should_fail_because: function-like macro invoked without parentheses
chapter-5/5.6--wrong-identifiers.sv 2 # should_fail_because: identifiers starting with a digit or $
chapter-6/6.19--enum_value_inv.sv 2 # should_fail_because: invalid enum value
chapter-6/6.19--enum_xx_inv.sv 2 # should_fail_because: invalid enum value
chapter-6/6.19--enum_xx_inv_order.sv 2 # should_fail_because: invalid enum value
chapter-6/6.20.5--specparam_inv.sv 1 # should_fail_because: invalid specparam -- also see the specparam entry below (not implemented regardless)
chapter-6/6.9.2--vector_vectored_inv.sv 1 # should_fail_because: invalid vectored net declaration
chapter-7/structures/packed/default-value.sv 1 # should_fail_because: invalid packed struct default value
chapter-8/8.25.1--parametrized_class_invalid_scope_resolution.sv 1 # should_fail_because: invalid parametrized-class scope resolution
chapter-8/8.26.4--illegal_forward_def_implements.sv 3 # should_fail_because: illegal forward-typedef interface-class implements
chapter-8/8.26.6.2--parameter_type_conflict_unresolved.sv 2 # should_fail_because: unresolved parameter type conflict
chapter-8/8.26.6.3--diamond_relationship_parametrized.sv 6 # should_fail_because: invalid parametrized diamond relationship

# --- Out of scope: non-ANSI port declarations (ports declared by name in the header, direction given separately in the body) ---
chapter-22/22.6--ifdef-behavioral.sv 2 # non-ANSI port declaration ("output"/"input" in the body)
chapter-22/22.6--ifdef-nested.sv 1 # non-ANSI port declaration ("output out;" in the body)

# --- Out of scope: preprocessor macro operators this preprocessor doesn't implement ---
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_25.sv 1 # escaped-quote-within-stringify operator (`\`") not implemented -- the `" / `" stringize delimiters themselves are supported

# --- Out of scope: `include forms this preprocessor doesn't resolve ---
chapter-22/22.5.1--include-define-expansion.sv 2 # `include argument built via a macro invocation (stringize-expanded to a path) -- handleInclude doesn't macro-expand its argument before checking it's a quoted literal
chapter-5/5.6.4--compiler-directives-include.sv 1 # `include "/dev/null" -- absolute path outside the vendored corpus, platform-specific, not resolved by this harness's relative resolver

# --- Out of scope: `begin_keywords/`end_keywords dynamic keyword-set switching (LRM 22.11) ---
chapter-5/5.6.4--compiler-directives-begin-keywords.sv 3 # relies on `begin_keywords changing which identifiers are keywords; not implemented

# --- Out of scope: this harness has no :defines: metadata support ---
chapter-5/5.6.4--compiler-directives-preprocessor-macro_0.sv 2 # requires :defines: TEST_VAR (an external +define+, not something in the source itself); without it the file's own `else branch is (intentionally) invalid placeholder text

# --- Out of scope: bare (non-typedef'd) enum/struct/union used inline as a variable's type -- documented limitation ---

# --- Out of scope: niche net qualifiers (already a documented limitation) ---
